scope: After an explicitly chosen family and authorized additive native import. Nothing in this plan runs automatically.
safety: Games closed and a supported native inspector first. Stop on unexpected/stuck input, discomfort or unknown effects; never force a repeated key test.

tests.instruction: With BASIC selected and games closed, hold native button 2, observe NUMBERS, then release it.
tests.expected: Correct bank remains active while held; release returns to BASIC with no second press or stuck output.
tests.known_limit: The candidate has a reciprocal link; file presence is not an observed event.

tests.instruction: With BASIC selected and games closed, hold native button 1, observe MENUS, then release it.
tests.expected: Correct bank remains active while held; release returns to BASIC with no second press or stuck output.
tests.known_limit: The candidate has a reciprocal link; file presence is not an observed event.

tests.known_limit: The candidate has a reciprocal link; file presence is not an observed event.

tests.instruction: Using a supported native input inspector, check Ctrl on button 5 in each selected bank without running a game.
tests.expected: The expected keyboard output is generated and fully released.

tests.instruction: Using a supported native input inspector, check Shift on button 9 in each selected bank without running a game.
tests.expected: The expected keyboard output is generated and fully released.

tests.instruction: Using a supported native input inspector, check Space on button 14 in each selected bank without running a game.
tests.expected: The expected keyboard output is generated and fully released.

tests.instruction: Test one anchor at a time: anchor down, layer selector down/up, then anchor up. Inspect every release; do not test all anchors together.
tests.expected: No stuck or phantom key. Stop and record the exact order on failure.

tests.instruction: Check the BASIC Alt output on button 3 while moving the stick, then release both.
tests.expected: Reach and release are comfortable and deliberate. File/model availability is not sufficient.

tests.instruction: Check whether the BASIC T placement on thumb31 meets the actual game task; do not assume independent stick use.
tests.expected: Record the tradeoff explicitly; a discomfort or concurrent-use failure is useful evidence, not a reason to force the position.

tests.instruction: Check 0 in NUMBERS with the selector held; record whether movement must be released.
tests.expected: The bank returns to BASIC cleanly and the access requirement fits the intended game.

tests.instruction: Check a required Ctrl+number route using one Ctrl copy at a time. Release the number and Ctrl before the selector until transition behavior is verified.
tests.expected: No duplicate modifier or missing key-up. Do not count merely separate button reach as a successful chord.

tests.instruction: Confirm button19 remains reserved and that no unsupported external trigger has been introduced.
tests.expected: No game or keyboard shortcut assigned by this package. External Overlay integration is still separate.
